newsitem.title: USA: U.S. West Coast crudes flat, ANS part-cargo sold.
newsitem.headline: U.S. West Coast crudes flat, ANS part-cargo sold.

text.p: U.S. West Coast crude prices were flat for the third-straight day Thursday, and traders reported a half-cargo of Alaskan crude sold.
BP on Thursday sold 100,000 barrels of Alaska North Slope (ANS) to a small West Coast refiner for -$0.85 off WTI, traders said.
The shipment was too small to influence overall discounts, which remain -$0.91 off WTI.
Other light grades were unchanged, with Line 63 prices holding at postings plus $0.95 to $1.00.
Outright ANS prices stayed at Wednesday's level of $20.99/21.19 a barrel.
Outright prices for Kern River were steady after increasing Tuesday. Kern River, a key heavy grade, ranged $14.88/14.98 a barrel Monday.
